title: ModelerSymbolSource
description: One symbol source of the Portunix Modeler source registry (ptx-modeler, portunix-plugins #130): a collection of symbols with one origin, license and set of formats, e.g. the QElectroTech elements or the KiCad symbol libraries. Files use the '.msrc.json' filename suffix and are named '<id>.msrc.json'. The registry loads curated entries shipped with the plugin, user entries and --sources directories; later layers override earlier ones by id. The support status is computed from the converters of the running binary and is never stored.

id.description: Registry id; referenced by search results and by the resolvable origin of converted symbols

url.description: Repository URL used for fetching (git clone)

formats.description: Symbol file formats of the source

path.description: Directory of the source that follows the standard

categories.description: Directories with localized names, searchable without a local index

index.description: How a local index is built: clone = index a local checkout; names = format whose files carry the descriptive names

trackingIssue.description: portunix-plugins issue that tracks support for the formats without a converter

verified.description: Date a human verified the license facts

spdx.description: SPDX license expression; NOASSERTION when unclear

usage.description: Terms beyond the SPDX identifier in plain words, e.g. what is allowed in diagrams

restrictions.description: Restrictions an agent must pass on to the user before fetching

license.description: License facts, verified by a human for curated entries
